summary: This video examines top Temporal Vortex leaderboard teams on the S9 Chinese server to see how new Season 9 heroes and mythic gear are performing. Key new Aura supports like Holfast and Celestine are making significant impacts in top-tier Aura teams alongside Solmo and Anneliesis. The new Dragonflame mythic gloves provide strong damage bonuses, though slightly weaker than the previous Realm of the Fallen set. Corrosion teams are also showing early promise as players prepare for upcoming exclusive Corrosion hero releases.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Provides massive buffs including 30% Damage Up, Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Attack to Aura allies via his passive and battle skill.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Provides a substantial boost to the overall HP pool and durability of Aura team compositions.

heroes.note: Grants 10% damage increase and 10% damage reduction to allies, though not yet mainstream in the top meta.

Holfast and Celestine elevate Aura team damage and survivability significantly in S9 Temporal Vortex.
